method: read-only source sweep of flow-companion/bridge/* + extension background/content + tests/flow (Explore agent, very thorough)

findings.title: Artifact transport cap (256KB) contradicts the 60MB artifact limit; real media can never be imported via the bridge
findings.evidence: flow-companion/bridge/server.js:59 (256KB readBody) vs :37 (ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES 60MB); artifact arrives base64 in the same JSON body
findings.impact: panel-driven import unreachable for real Flow outputs; PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE surfaced as 500
findings.recommendedAction: per-route body cap (ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES*4/3 + slack) + map PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE to 400
findings.status: FIXED (readBody Buffer-safe + per-route cap + 400 mapping; tests/flow/test-flow-hardening.js H5/H6)

findings.title: Lost ACK after a provider-accepted submit can produce a second generation (no durable submit-issued record; approval overwrite)
findings.evidence: bridge has no submit-issued state; /approve + recordApproval overwrite unused approvals (server.js:145-153, job-store.js:82-91); worker approval map volatile; panel retry re-records approval then re-submits
findings.impact: duplicate credit spend possible — the exact class the pipeline must prevent
findings.recommendedAction: durable submit-issued record + state; recordApproval refuses unused-approval overwrite without supersedes nonce; /generate binds approval nonce
findings.status: FIXED (AWAITING_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE state + POST /jobs/:id/submit-issued route + DUPLICATE_APPROVAL guard + APPROVAL_NONCE_MISMATCH binding; tests H1–H4)

findings.title: No distinct provider-execution ACK states; unknown submit outcome has no reconciliation entry
findings.evidence: state-machine.js transitions; RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED only reachable from GENERATING
findings.impact: a missed acceptance signal leaves stale AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL that a later approval can re-submit
findings.status: FIXED (state added; H8 verifies RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED exit)

findings.title: job-store read-modify-write unsynchronized (concurrent routes lose updates)
findings.status: VERIFIED-NOT-A-BUG (all mutator bodies are fully synchronous fs work with no await — on Node's single-threaded event loop two requests can never interleave inside a cycle; atomicity note added to job-store.js. A mutex was prototyped and removed because async plumbing changed mutator return contracts without adding guarantees)

findings.title: Bridge records approvals without settings-tuple fingerprint binding; no generationUnitId
findings.evidence: server.js /approve accepts {jobId, attempt, approvedBy} only; binding enforced extension-side only
findings.impact: durable layer cannot distinguish exact-tuple approval
findings.recommendedAction: require fingerprint with nonce at /approve; bind approval nonce at /generate
findings.status: FIXED (fingerprint-required-with-nonce at /approve; APPROVAL_NONCE_MISMATCH at /generate; approval nonce recorded + echoed)

findings.title: Origin allowlists treat every chrome-extension:// origin as trusted (worker validateSender, sender-check, bridge allowlist prefix)
findings.impact: a co-installed malicious extension can drive the content-script command surface unauthenticated
findings.recommendedAction: pin chrome.runtime.id for extension senders in worker + sender-check; bridge keeps token gate

findings.title: Side-panel bridgeCall has no timeout (duplicate of Track B finding B-2)
findings.impact: hung bridge → dead silent wait on credit path

findings.title: POST /jobs never validates the flow-job contract
findings.evidence: server.js:106-114; contracts/job-contract.js checkJobShape never applied bridge-side
findings.impact: missing requestId fails only at import time (late)
findings.recommendedAction: checkJobShape in createJob route; reject SCHEMA_INVALID
findings.status: FIXED (server validates via contracts/job-contract.js before persisting; test H7)

findings.title: Wire messages carry no contractVersion/correlationId; per-command identity partial
findings.evidence: content-commands.js:75-79 validates only type; no correlationId anywhere
findings.impact: stale build reported not rejected; no cross-layer correlation id
findings.recommendedAction: stamp commands with {contractVersion, jobId, attempt, correlationId}
findings.status: BACKLOG (submit-issued + approval-nonce binding covers the credit path)

findings.title: Cancellation does not propagate after result detection (RESULT_DETECTED has no CANCELLED exit; poll loop never re-checks status)
findings.impact: panel keeps polling a cancelled job

findings.title: Unbounded in-memory maps in content script (AWAIT_BASELINES, acceptancePolls)
findings.impact: page-lifetime leak, few entries per job

findings.title: Acceptance-baseline recapture after tab refresh can make an accepted submit unobservable
findings.recommendedAction: treat submitIssuedAt + new candidates as acceptance evidence

findings.title: readBody concatenates Buffer chunks as strings (UTF-8 boundary corruption)

clean: constant-time token compare; token persisted 0600 outside repo; env override never printed
single-use approval chain (content check → worker consume → machine used+generationCount) well-guarded and well-tested (E9, C10, BR11, BR12)
stale approval packet + tuple change after approval covered (E7/E8 APPROVAL_STALE_CHANGED)
result replay/download replay/import retry covered (E10/E14/E15, D1–D3, L5/L6)
coverageGaps: unknown submit outcome (vs uncertain result): NO COVERAGE (H8 adds state-machine level)
lost ACK + retry: NO COVERAGE (H1–H4 add bridge level)
concurrent delivery race: N/A (see C-4 atomicity note)
large-payload artifact path: NO COVERAGE (H6 adds)
cross-extension sender rejection: NO COVERAGE (open with C-6)
backpressure/queue bounds: NO COVERAGE (single-job UI implicit)
